params.name: space_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the Storyblok space.

items.docs: Returns the details of a Storyblok space including its name, plan, regional endpoint, domain configuration, language settings, and statistics. This endpoint is useful for validating space access and retrieving configuration needed for other API calls.

params.name: space_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the Storyblok space.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for paginated results, starting at 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of results per page. Maximum 100.

params.name: with_tag
params.description: Filter stories that have this tag applied.

params.name: folder_only
params.description: Set to 1 to only return folder stories.

params.name: story_only
params.description: Set to 1 to exclude folder stories from the results.

params.name: by_slugs
params.description: Comma-separated list of full_slug values to filter by.

params.name: search
params.description: Text search to filter stories by name.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Field and direction to sort by, formatted as field:asc or field:desc.

params.name: starts_with
params.description: Filter stories whose full_slug starts with this prefix.

params.name: in_trash
params.description: Set to 1 to return only stories in the trash.

params.name: in_release
params.description: Filter stories belonging to a specific release ID.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of stories in the space. The response includes both published and draft stories. Results can be filtered by folder, publication status, component type, and text search.

params.name: space_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the Storyblok space.

items.docs: Creates a new story in the space. The request body must include the story name, slug, and content object. Optionally specify a parent_id to nest the story inside a folder. Stories are created in draft state unless publish is set to 1.

params.name: space_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the Storyblok space.

params.name: story_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the story.

items.docs: Returns the full details of a single story by its numeric ID, including draft content, workflow state, locks, and publishing history.

params.name: space_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the Storyblok space.

params.name: story_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the story.

items.docs: Updates an existing story's content, metadata, or settings. Only the fields provided in the request body are updated. Set publish to 1 to publish the story as part of the update.

params.name: space_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the Storyblok space.

params.name: story_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the story.

items.docs: Permanently deletes a story from the space. This action cannot be undone. Deleting a folder story also deletes all stories nested within it.

params.name: space_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the Storyblok space.

params.name: story_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the story.

params.name: release_id
params.description: Publish the story as part of a specific release rather than immediately to production.

params.name: lang
params.description: Language code to publish a specific translation of the story.

items.docs: Publishes the current draft version of a story, making it available via the Content Delivery API with the public token. If the story has a scheduled publication date, this endpoint publishes it immediately regardless of the schedule.

params.name: space_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the Storyblok space.

params.name: story_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the story.

items.docs: Unpublishes a story, removing it from public access via the Content Delivery API. The story's draft content is preserved and can be republished at any time.

params.name: space_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the Storyblok space.

params.name: search
params.description: Filter components by name using a partial text match.

params.name: in_groups
params.description: Comma-separated list of component group UUIDs to filter components by their assigned group.

items.docs: Returns all component definitions for the space. Components define the content schema used by stories, including field names, types, and validation rules.

params.name: space_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the Storyblok space.

items.docs: Creates a new component definition in the space. The component schema specifies the field definitions that will be available to stories using this component.

params.name: space_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the Storyblok space.

params.name: component_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the component.

items.docs: Returns the full schema definition of a single component by its numeric ID, including all field definitions and their configuration.

params.name: space_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the Storyblok space.

params.name: component_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the component.

items.docs: Updates an existing component definition. Changes to the schema affect all stories that use this component.

params.name: space_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the Storyblok space.

params.name: component_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the component.

items.docs: Deletes a component definition from the space. Stories that reference this component will retain their existing content but the schema validation will no longer apply.

params.name: space_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the Storyblok space.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for paginated results, starting at 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of results per page. Maximum 100.

params.name: in_folder
params.description: Filter assets within a specific asset folder ID.

params.name: search
params.description: Filter assets by filename using a partial text match.

params.name: content_type
params.description: Filter assets by MIME type, such as image/jpeg or application/pdf.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of assets in the space. Assets can be filtered by content type, folder, and filename search. The response includes the asset URL and metadata.

params.name: space_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the Storyblok space.

items.docs: Initiates the asset upload process by requesting a signed upload URL from Storyblok's asset CDN. After receiving the signed URL and form fields, upload the file directly to the CDN using a multipart POST request, then call the asset finalization endpoint.

params.name: space_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the Storyblok space.

params.name: asset_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the asset.

items.docs: Returns the full metadata for a single asset by its numeric ID, including its CDN URL, dimensions, content type, and associated tags.

params.name: space_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the Storyblok space.

params.name: asset_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the asset.

items.docs: Permanently deletes an asset from the space's asset library and removes it from the CDN. This action cannot be undone. Stories referencing this asset will display broken media after deletion.

params.name: space_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the Storyblok space.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for paginated results, starting at 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of results per page. Maximum 100.

items.docs: Returns all datasources defined in the space. Use this endpoint to enumerate available datasources before creating, updating, or deleting their entries.

params.name: space_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the Storyblok space.

items.docs: Creates a new datasource in the space. Optionally define dimensions to support locale-specific or variant values alongside the default entries.

params.name: space_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the Storyblok space.

items.docs: Returns a list of all collaborators who have access to the space, including their roles, permissions, and invitation status.

params.name: space_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the Storyblok space.

items.docs: Invites a user to the space by email address and assigns them a role. If the user already has a Storyblok account they will be added immediately; otherwise an invitation email is sent.

params.name: space_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the Storyblok space.

params.name: collaborator_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the collaborator to remove.

items.docs: Removes a collaborator from the space, revoking their access. The user's Storyblok account is not deleted; they simply lose access to this space.

params.name: space_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the Storyblok space.

items.docs: Returns all webhook endpoints configured for the space, including their target URLs, event subscriptions, and optional secret configuration.

params.name: space_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the Storyblok space.

items.docs: Registers a new webhook endpoint to receive event notifications from the space. Specify the target URL, the events to subscribe to, and an optional secret for signature validation.

params.name: space_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the Storyblok space.

params.name: webhook_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the webhook endpoint.

items.docs: Returns the configuration of a single webhook endpoint by its numeric ID.

params.name: space_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the Storyblok space.

params.name: webhook_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the webhook endpoint.

items.docs: Updates an existing webhook endpoint's URL, subscribed events, or secret key.

params.name: space_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the Storyblok space.

params.name: webhook_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the webhook endpoint.

items.docs: Permanently removes a webhook endpoint from the space. No further event notifications will be sent to the associated URL.
